_comment: Committed on purpose: every clone gets the same grants and a reviewer can read them.
An entry ending in `:*` is a prefix match. An open `git fetch` wildcard is
deliberately absent, because git's ext:: transport turns a fetch url into a command.
There is no build or test step in this repository - it is hand-written static HTML -
so the only grants here are read-only git inspection and the page generator.
